title: Vol / breadth
lede: Spot Vol Beta is the gauge on this wall. Daily closes carry an SPX overlay and a band at 2. Credit, the seven-name oscillator, and the summation indexes are hooked beside it.

hooks.title: Credit spread regime
hooks.blurb: Daily spread Z with SPX behind it. Elevated from about 1, stress from about 2.

hooks.title: MAG7 oscillator
hooks.blurb: Equal-weight seven-name momentum. Signal lines at +2% and −2%, with pivot lines near −5 and +9.

hooks.title: NYSI
hooks.blurb: McClellan summation, one-year daily, with a buy line at −1,000. The range can run out to ten years.

hooks.title: NASI
hooks.blurb: Nasdaq McClellan summation on the same daily scale, the same buy line, and the same range.
